subject.title: fix: show readable session names across Windows UX

question: Should Windows adopt the proposed Gateway presentation contract and hide background session families by default across chat, tray, dashboard, and Sessions UX, with opt-in visibility only on the Sessions page?
rationale: Tests and native proof establish implementation behavior, but they cannot decide the permanent cross-repository contract or whether removing background sessions from currently reachable navigation is intended product policy.

options.title: Approve contract and policy
options.body: Accept the additive Gateway schema and proposed visibility defaults, then coordinate landing after rebasing this draft.

options.title: Split titles from visibility
options.body: Land readable titles and structured grouping while preserving existing visibility, then review background filtering separately.

options.title: Defer Windows consumption
options.body: Wait until the upstream Gateway producer contract is merged and stable before finalizing the Windows parser and UX.

recommendation.title: Approve contract and policy
recommendation.body: Accept the additive Gateway schema and proposed visibility defaults, then coordinate landing after rebasing this draft.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Gateway-client and tray history makes this person the strongest available owner for the cross-repository compatibility choice.
